entries.name: Mage
entries: Students with a keen intellect and unwavering discipline may walk the path of the mage. The arcane magic available to mages is both great and dangerous, and it is revealed only to the most devoted practitioners. To avoid interference with their spellcasting, mages wear no armor, instead protecting themselves with arcane shields and enchantments. To keep enemies at bay, mages can summon bursts of fire to incinerate distant targets and cause entire areas to erupt, setting groups of foes ablaze.

Mages are found among many peoples and cultures of Azeroth, and they're regarded with varying degrees of suspicion. Thousands of years ago, Highborne night elf mages collaborated with their queen, Azshara, to turn the Well of Eternity into a portal through which the Burning Legion could enter Azeroth. The resulting conflict—the War of the Ancients—shattered the continent, leaving many night elves and others wary of mages and their hunger for power. The Highborne subsequently settled in the Eastern Kingdoms, where they eventually shared their magic with a select group of humans. These human mages, faced with suspicion from their own people, founded the city-state of Dalaran, which was ruled by a senate of mages called the Kirin Tor. (The Kirin Tor is described in {@book chapter 4|WoW|4|Kirin Tor}.)
